description:
If goods shall be shipped, the secretary clarifies who will do the shipping. 
If you have large amounts, special shipping will be necessary. 
In these cases the secretary invites three logistic companies to make offers and she selects one of them. 
In case of small amounts, normal post shipment is used. 
Therefore a package label is written by the secretary and a parcel insurance taken by the logistics department head if necessary. 
In the meantime the goods can be already packaged by the warehousemen. 
If everything is ready, the packaged goods are prepared for being picked up by the logistic company.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Shipping"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/shipping">

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Shipping" name="Shipping of goods" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Shipping">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Secretary" name="Secretary">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_GoodsToBeShipped</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ClarifyShipper</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_AmountSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InviteCompanies</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectCompany</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NormalPost</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_ShippingMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_ParallelSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_LabelSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_WriteLabel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_LabelJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_LogisticsHead" name="Logistics department head">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Insurance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Warehousemen" name="Warehousemen">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Package</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_ReadyJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_ReadyMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_ReadyCheck</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareForPickup</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_ReadyForPickup</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_GoodsToBeShipped" name="Goods shall be shipped"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ClarifyShipper" name="Clarify who will do the shipping"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_AmountSplit" name="Large amounts?" default="Flow_SmallAmount"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_InviteCompanies" name="Invite three logistic companies to make offers"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectCompany" name="Select one logistic company"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_NormalPost" name="Ship by normal post"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_ShippingMerge" name="Shipping mode determined"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="GW_ParallelSplit" name="Start packaging and label preparation"/>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_Package" name="Package goods"/>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="GW_LabelSplit" name="Insurance necessary?"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_WriteLabel" name="Write package label"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Insurance" name="Take out parcel insurance"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="GW_LabelJoin" name="Label and insurance completed"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="GW_ReadyJoin" name="Packaging and label completed"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_ReadyMerge" name="Check readiness"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_ReadyCheck" name="Everything ready?" default="Flow_NotReady"/>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_PrepareForPickup" name="Prepare packaged goods for pickup by logistic company"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ReadyForPickup" name="Goods ready for pickup"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToClarify" sourceRef="Start_GoodsToBeShipped" targetRef="Task_ClarifyShipper"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ClarifyToAmount" sourceRef="Task_ClarifyShipper" targetRef="GW_AmountSplit"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LargeAmount" name="Large" sourceRef="GW_AmountSplit" targetRef="Task_InviteCompanies">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${amountLarge == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SmallAmount" name="Small" sourceRef="GW_AmountSplit" targetRef="Task_NormalPost"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InviteToSelect" sourceRef="Task_InviteCompanies" targetRef="Task_SelectCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectToMerge" sourceRef="Task_SelectCompany" targetRef="GW_ShippingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostToMerge" sourceRef="Task_NormalPost" targetRef="GW_ShippingMerge"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToParallel" sourceRef="GW_ShippingMerge" targetRef="GW_ParallelSplit"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ParallelToPackage" sourceRef="GW_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_Package"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ParallelToLabelSplit" sourceRef="GW_ParallelSplit" targetRef="GW_LabelSplit"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LabelSplitToLabel" name="Always" sourceRef="GW_LabelSplit" targetRef="Task_WriteLabel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LabelSplitToInsurance" name="Yes" sourceRef="GW_LabelSplit" targetRef="Task_Insurance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${insuranceNecessary == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LabelToLabelJoin" sourceRef="Task_WriteLabel" targetRef="GW_LabelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsuranceToLabelJoin" sourceRef="Task_Insurance" targetRef="GW_LabelJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LabelJoinToReady" sourceRef="GW_LabelJoin" targetRef="GW_ReadyJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PackageToReady" sourceRef="Task_Package" targetRef="GW_ReadyJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReadyJoinToMerge" sourceRef="GW_ReadyJoin" targetRef="GW_ReadyMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReadyMergeToCheck" sourceRef="GW_ReadyMerge" targetRef="GW_ReadyCheck"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReadyYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="GW_ReadyCheck" targetRef="Task_PrepareForPickup">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${everythingReady == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotReady" name="No, check again" sourceRef="GW_ReadyCheck" targetRef="GW_ReadyMerge"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PickupToEnd" sourceRef="Task_PrepareForPickup" targetRef="End_ReadyForPickup"/>

  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
